query:
INSERT INTO game_resume_states (game_id, turn_number, food, hazards, updated_at)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NOW())
           ON CONFLICT (game_id) DO UPDATE SET
               turn_number = EXCLUDED.turn_number,
               food = EXCLUDED.food,
               hazards = EXCLUDED.hazards,
               updated_at = NOW()
